rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for evaluating the value, quality, risk, or condition of something.

example.english: We need to assess the risks before deciding whether to go ahead.
example.traditional: 我哋要先評估風險，先決定做唔做。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 ping4 gu2 fung1 him2 sin1 kyut3 ding6 zou6 m4 zou6

rows.note: Use this specifically when the tax authority calculates the tax a person or organization owes.

example.english: The tax authority carries out an annual process to assess the tax due.
example.jyutping: seoi3 mou6 guk6 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 ping4 seoi3

rows.note: Use this when an official or referee imposes a penalty for an infraction, especially in sports.

example.english: The referee had to assess a penalty against the other team.
example.traditional: 球證判罰咗對方一個十二碼。
example.jyutping: kau4 zing3 pun3 fat6 zo2 deoi3 fong1 jat1 go3 sap6 ji6 maa5
